notes.title: packet.Breach() 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
This is a teeny update with a few changes and bugfixes following release day.
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Beta (the Ingress program that comes from Alpha) now grants +2 damage instead of x2 damage
[*]Gamma (the Ingress program that comes from Beta) now grants +3 damage instead of x3 damage (it still splits the packet 3-ways)
[*]The fourth program option in the level-up menu (the one that always has a different faction's program) will always be common if the random faction is not yet unlocked
[*]Reduced the difficulty of the first server, mostly by removing some of the excessive walls near the start of the level (servers two and three remain as difficult as ever)
[*]The tutorial now stresses the importance of pausing
[*]The tutorial now teaches how to overwrite programs (you can do that, for those that didn't know)
[*]Other incremental improvements to the tutorial
[*]Updated credits with fuller font
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed cognition not actually granting experience (previously, it would appear to grant experience, but it was never added to the experience bar)
[*]Fixed some programs playing the wrong sound effect when deployed
[*]Fixed a bug where the fourth program option in the level-up menu would always be rare or legendary (we all thought we were lucky, but 'twas not so)
[/list]

notes.title: packet.Breach() 1.0, Released!
notes.content:
After much longing, packet.Breach() is available to all, after an extended development time! Thank you all for enjoying the demo and continuing to be excited for the release! Thank you very very much!

This update also comes with Steam Cloud support and achievements. There are 25 achievements in total, and some of them are quite difficult to obtain.

1.0 releases with 100 programs in total, across 4 factions. Now that you have access to the full game and all of the factions, let us know which is your favorite! I have a soft spot for Ingress, myself.

tags.feature: - This update also comes with Steam Cloud support and achievements.

notes.title: Update 0.6: Procedural Generation!
notes.content:
[h1]Procedural Generation Update[/h1]

Hello all!

Today, we're bringing a number of changes to the game that I'm happy to have. Some quality-of-life improvements are here to stay (and more shall follow!), and the biggest update is bringing the procedural generation to the demo. Previously you could only play on the two static levels, but we figured it would be a bit more fun to see some of the level diversity before you buy the game.

Also! Development on the full game is going smoothly, although we've encountered some hitches that prevented us from releasing the game when we wanted to. We were aiming to release today, but alas! We will have to delay a wee bit. I don't anticipate a huge delay—no more than 2 weeks—although I'm still sad that we couldn't release on time. Oh well, lessons learned!

This whole project has been a huge undertaking for the team since we had very little time to work on it. There are some features that I really wanted to add to 1.0, although they will have to be introduced later in some free updates. And yes, we will absolutely be updating the game with free content updates post-release! I'm really looking forward to working on them. More information coming later!

For now, here are some changes that we've shipped over to the demo. Enjoy!

[h1]Version 0.6 Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
- Added procedural generation to demo.
- Added visual timer to clock programs.
- Added warning signal when a new wave is about to start. Programs that are about to be destroyed by the firewall will blink a few times, first.
- Added a wee little wiggle to packets. Daw, so cute.
- Added overstock warning. When your stock is full, the stock indicator will flash red and say "Overstocked!"
- Added tooltip to piston architectures.
- Added icon to game executable. How'd we miss that?

[h2]Changed[/h2]
- Changed Chimera faction description.
- Changed dancer program description.
- Changed stock description.
- Changed appearance of tutorial UI indicators.

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
- Fixed first-run cinematic occurring when you return to the main menu until you restart the game. Worst bug ever!
- Fixed win sound playing when returning to the main menu without winning.
- Fixed fury and overclock programs adding their bonuses when destroyed instead of removing their bonuses.
- Fixed some audio bugs involving sounds playing during slow-motion.

notes.title: packet.Breach() v0.5.2 released
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new rare unaffiliated programs: Drum, Dancer, Mosh, and Nightmare.
[*] Added 1 new legendary unaffiliated program, unlocked by default: Fury.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sand program now slows down packets twice instead of once.
[*] Spark program is now destroyed after 5 breaches instead of after 1 breach.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made tutorial easier.
[*] Pause tooltip now indicates that spacebar is a hotkey.
[*] Adjusted colors for the Gemicorn and Scholar programs.
[*] Updated opening menu cinematic.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Cyst program incorrectly stating that its clock speed is 1s. It now properly displays 2s.
[*] Fixed tutorial UI not displaying properly on non-16:9 aspect ratios.
[*] Fixed health tooltip to no longer reference "Connection."
[/list]
